evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies connection manager (Connman) socket-event handling to disconnect on error events.
rationale: Prevents potential CPU spinning and busy loops on select()-based platforms when peers send urgent data. As noted in the PR description, 'On select() based platform (BSDs, macOS and Windows), ErrorEvent can be returned if a peer sends us urgent data... we can't read that urgent data, and this means we could be continuously woken up.'
